scenes.setting: Spirit-body wanderings over Tingen: invisible above Daffodil Street, through Iron Cross Street's corporeal gloom, past the smokestacks — until his spirituality runs low
scenes.text_anchor: The weather in Tingen turned from refreshing cool to a bitingly chill

scenes.setting: Above the gray fog: ending the summon lands him at the seat of honor WITH the Flaring Sun Charm — corporeal items can enter the mysterious space
scenes.text_anchor: Silence was everywhere in the boundless gray fog

scenes.setting: Back in the bedroom: a carefully vague letter to Azik about Qilangos and sacrificial rituals, handed to the towering bone messenger via the copper whistle
scenes.text_anchor: In the blink of an eye, he returned to his bedroom.
